subject: Request: temporary runway while PO completes
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearline.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearline.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T09:14:00Z
Subject: Pilot access — procurement routing delay

Hi Aisha,

Quick note from procurement: our PO routing hit a higher-priority finance audit and the approvers are delayed. We expect the PO to clear within 6–10 business days, but that timeline is not firm.

The engineering team needs to keep the pilot running (we're mid-integration and a few regressions popped up we'd like to verify). Can Redwood provide a short temporary extension or token top-up while the PO is in flight? If there are terms we need to accept (e.g., short-term credit acknowledgement), let me know and I can route approval internally.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Procurement
Clearline Systems

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearline.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement routing delay

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear about the audit timing. We want to keep your integration momentum going. Two quick Qs so I can loop in ops:

1) Do you have a rough PO amount/value we should tie a temporary credit to?
2) Will procurement require an explicit written acceptance of temporary credits (signed PDF) or is a procurement email sufficient?

If procurement prefers a signed acknowledgement, we can draft a short 1-paragraph form (no legal-heavy terms) and attach it. I’ve CC'd Michael for internal approval on the short-term top-up so we can move quickly.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T17:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement routing delay

Aisha — appreciate the flag. From a deal/ops perspective we can approve a one-time provisional credit to preserve the pilot, provided Clearline signs a short acknowledgement and we cap the top-up to a conservative amount.

Proposal: 75,000 token credit (estimated 3–5 days at current usage) with an automatic reversal if the PO doesn't arrive within 14 calendar days. Ask procurement to confirm a contact who will sign the acknowledgement (we prefer procurement or legal). We can also exchange a simple DocuSign (one-liner).

If procurement needs a faster option and is comfortable with an email acceptance, we can accept that as interim, but I'd like a signed acknowledgement as the default.

If you confirm the customer contact, I’ll sign off and ops will provision the top-up today.

—Michael
Michael Grant
Director, Commercial Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearline.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@clearline.com>
Date: 2028-03-02T10:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement routing delay

Thanks, Michael. Sanjay / Procurement — based on Michael's note, Redwood can provide a provisional 75,000 token credit to keep the pilot live. Options for acceptance:

- Fast path (preferred by Clearline): Procurement email reply confirming acceptance of the temporary credit and acknowledging that the credit will be reconciled against the forthcoming PO.

- Signed path: We attach a one-paragraph acknowledgement (attached: Clearline_PO_Draft.pdf). If you prefer this, please confirm signer and I'll send a DocuSign link.

Next steps:
1) Sanjay / procurement: reply with which acceptance path you prefer and the signer name/email.
2) Once we have confirmation, Michael will authorize ops to provision the 75,000 token credit (estimated 3–5 days of usage).

Attached: proposal-CLR-20280301.xlsx (breakdown of estimated token consumption by integration test) and Clearline_PO_Draft.pdf (acknowledgement template).

Appreciate the quick turnaround here — we want the integration to stay on schedule.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Clearline_PO_Draft.pdf (pdf), proposal-CLR-20280301.xlsx (spreadsheet)
